entries.answer: A prime number is a whole number greater than 1 that divides evenly only by 1 and itself. The primes start 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19. Note that 1 is not prime, and 2 is the only even prime, because any other even number splits into twos. Primes are the atoms of number: every integer can be broken into them.

langs.tagalog: Ang prime number ay ang buong numero na mas malaki sa 1 at mahahati lamang nang pantay sa sarili niya at sa 1. Kaya 2, 3, 5, 7, 11 at 13 ay prime; ang 4, 6 at 9 ay hindi, sapagkat kayang basahin sa dalawa. May dalawang detalyeng madaling malingutin: ang 1 ay hindi prime, dahil isa lamang ang divisor nito at kailangan ng dalawa ang kahulugan; at ang 2 lamang ang even na prime, sapagkat ang ibang even na numero ay nahahati sa 2 na beses.multiply sa mas malaki sa 1. Ang mga pinakamaliit na factor ng isang numero lang ang kailangang suriin para malaman kung prime ito, kaya ang trial division ay tumitigil sa square root sa halip na umabot sa mismong numero.
langs.bisaya: Ang prime number mao ang whole nga numero nga labaw sa 1 ug mahahati lang nga equal sa iyang kaugalingon ug sa 1. Kana man, ang 2, 3, 5, 7, 11 ug 13 prime; ang 4, 6 ug 9 dili, tungod nga mabahin ra sila. Duha ka detalye nga kasagaran mali: ang 1 dili prime, tungod nga isa lang ang divisor niya ug duha ang kinahanglan sa definition; ug ang 2 lang ang even nga prime, tungod nga ang uban nga even nga numero mabahin sa 2 times usa ka butang nga labaw sa 1. Ang mga smallest nga factor nga naa sa usa ka numero lang iin ang imong i-check para mahimo nga prime, kana man nga ang trial division naa gyud sa square root sa dili sa mismong numero.

patterns: how do i calculate a percentage
entries.answer: A percentage is a fraction out of a hundred, so 25 percent is 25 out of 100 and equals one quarter. The operations that catch people are increase and decrease, because a 50 percent increase followed by a 50 percent decrease does not return to the original. A common and expensive mistake is treating a 20 percent discount on 80 pesos as taking off 20 pesos rather than 16.

entries.answer: A fraction expresses part of a whole, with a numerator over a denominator, and the two mean different things even when the numbers match. One half and two quarters are the same quantity in different forms, which is what reducing to a common denominator is for. Dividing is straightforward and multiplying needs the numerators and denominators handled separately, which is where most mistakes are made.

patterns: why do negative numbers have no square root
entries.answer: A square root is the value that multiplied by itself gives the number, and it is the only number which is its own square root. Negative numbers have no real square root, which is why the graph of x squared stops at zero, and this is the same reason complex numbers were invented: to allow the operation to continue. Every positive number has exactly two square roots, so the negative one is always there.

patterns: why are logs used for decibels
entries.answer: A logarithm is the exponent you need, so the log base 2 of 8 is 3 because two to the third is 8. That is the whole definition, and it makes the second name sensible, because a logarithm and an exponent answer the same question from opposite ends. Its importance is that it turns multiplication into addition, which is why logs appear in the scale of sound intensity, in decibels, and in pH.

entries.answer: A sequence is an ordered list of numbers following a rule, and the two that matter most are arithmetic and geometric. An arithmetic sequence adds a constant each time, a geometric one multiplies, and the second grows far faster. The useful fact is that an arithmetic sequence sums to the average of the first and last times the count, which is much easier than adding a hundred terms one at a time.
